answers.answer: Open Triggers and timers, then Timers, and choose New timer. Give it a name such as Break reminder. Keep Reaction at Simple reply; put Stretch and get water. and New here? Welcome! on two separate lines in Messages. Keep Minutes between posts at 30 and Send the reply to at Twitch chat, then choose Create timer. It starts switched on with Chat lines needed at 0. The first line is due at the next timer check, usually within about 30 seconds, rather than after 30 minutes. Later firings rotate the lines in order after each 30-minute wait and eligible check.

answers.answer: It needs neither a live stream nor an existing pipeline for a simple reply. Sign in and select the channel. Editing access defaults to Moderator, Lead moderator, Editor or Broadcaster, subject to a raised requirement. The bot must be running and connected to that channel. A VIP granted read access sees the list but cannot edit.
quote: Sign in and select your channel.
By default, a Moderator, Lead moderator, Editor or Broadcaster can change its timers and chat triggers.
The broadcaster can raise the required role on Permissions.
The bot must be running and connected to the channel to check timers and receive chat.
Timers can post while the stream is offline, so switch off a reminder when you finish if you only want it during broadcasts.
A simple reply needs no existing command or pipeline.
A VIP sees that tab’s list, without an editor.
New timer and New trigger show “You can view this, but your role cannot change it.”

Welcome! after the following 30-minute interval and eligible check. Continued firings wrap to the first line. A counted Twitch chat firing means chat accepted the message. To keep it from posting offline, switch Enabled off when the broadcast ends; that saves immediately and an off timer posts nothing.

answers.answer: this is nice matches because Contains the words accepts hi inside a longer word; HI matches because capitalization matching is off. With ! as the channel’s command prefix, !hi is excluded even if it is not a valid command. Eligible matches still depend on access and the default 30-second channel wait. To answer only the greeting, change How chat must match to Is exactly the words, leave Words to watch for as hi, and Save changes. With capitalization off, that still accepts HI.
quote: The text appears anywhere, including inside a longer word.
For example, hi with Contains the words also matches this.
Choose Is exactly the words to answer only the greeting, or use a suitable pattern for a more specific rule.
With Match capital letters off, Hello and hello match the same way.
A line starting with the channel’s command prefix is excluded, even when it does not run a valid command.
Seconds between replies is a wait for the whole channel, from 0 to 86400 seconds (one day), starting when an eligible match fires.
Choose Save changes to keep edits, or Discard to return to the saved trigger.
